title: Prairie Sports Complex
programme: Two 90 x 60 m soccer pitches with full markings, goals, bleachers and field lights; two Little League diamonds with backstops, dugouts, bleachers, lights and scoreboards, their home plates turned toward a central plaza and fieldhouse with a concession window and washrooms; an east-west promenade between the fields; an entrance spine with bike racks; prairie beds and groves of green ash, bur oak, spruce and aspen.
design_basis: Original concept after the catalogue sports field complex "Multi-Field Complex" references (variant 0). Pitch and diamond sizes are teaching values, not a sports facility design.
generator: CityPrompt native park batch builder v1 (complex)
limitations: Prepared level ground only; field drainage, irrigation and turf construction are not designed.
Pitches are 90 x 60 m, the smallest adult size; diamonds use Little League dimensions.
The fieldhouse is a closed massing; its interior, services and parking are not designed.
Lights, fences and bleachers are indicative; the scoreboards are blank.
The complete assembly stays rigid when its parcel changes; use a larger parcel to rotate it.
surface_priority: Assembly owns its ground: every surface inside the site is one tiled assembly.
axes: X east/across; Y north/along; Z up; metres (GLB standard Y-up conversion)
runtime_contract: Native assembly at true size on prepared level ground. Walk on paving, grass, gravel. Never stretch the assembly to fit.

card.description: Two soccer pitches and two ball diamonds round a central plaza and fieldhouse, with bleachers, field lights and a promenade. Prepared level ground.
